DEFINITIONS.LOGICAL_BYTES: Length of encoded intended records before write; excludes later retries/rewrites unless separately enumerated
DEFINITIONS.PERSISTED_BYTES: Bytes whose exact content and durability barriers plus independent reread are evidenced; no inference solely from write return
DEFINITIONS.RETAINED_BYTES: File content remaining at measurement end; omits overwritten/deleted prior writes and is not cumulative
DEFINITIONS.SUBMITTED_BYTES: Sum lengths of buffers passed to the defined API or syscall, including failed/partial/repeated submissions; API level must be specified
DEFINITIONS.TRANSFERRED_BYTES: Sum bytes reported successfully transferred by defined interface; not durable evidence
